speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Thermal telemetry online. Four thousand Kelvin at the source. We have reached the Foundry Forge.
subtitle: AXIOM-7: Thermal telemetry online. Four thousand Kelvin at the source. We have reached the Foundry Forge.

speaker: KAITO
text: Those conduits feed the Citadel sky-shields. Shut this reactor down, and their fortress loses its cover.
subtitle: KAITO: Those conduits feed the Citadel sky-shields. Shut this reactor down, and their fortress loses its cover.

speaker: TITAN
text: Forced labor built this place. Heavy coils, thick walls. They planned for a meltdown. They did not plan for us.
subtitle: TITAN: Forced labor built this place. Heavy coils, thick walls. They planned for a meltdown. They did not plan for us.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: Three aquifers drained to cool their turbines. Break the valves, and the river can take its course again.
subtitle: OCEANUS: Three aquifers drained to cool their turbines. Break the valves, and the river can take its course again.

speaker: AURA
text: That turbine is deafening. But beneath the grind, I can hear a fault in the containment lattice.
subtitle: AURA: That turbine is deafening. But beneath the grind, I can hear a fault in the containment lattice.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: Turrets on the catwalks. Slag below. I have a route over the coolant lines. Watch your footing.
subtitle: MIRAGE: Turrets on the catwalks. Slag below. I have a route over the coolant lines. Watch your footing.

speaker: SURYA
text: My bulwark will cover the radiation crossing. Once we breach the core, we move straight to extraction.
subtitle: SURYA // COMMS: My bulwark will cover the radiation crossing. Once we breach the core, we move straight to extraction.

speaker: TITAN
text: When that reactor goes, their shield goes with it. Let us see how brave they are without it.
subtitle: TITAN: When that reactor goes, their shield goes with it. Let us see how brave they are without it.

speaker: KAITO
text: Sever the coolant lines. Overload the reactor. Break their sky-shields. Axiom Force, drop in.
subtitle: KAITO: Sever the coolant lines. Overload the reactor. Break their sky-shields. Axiom Force, drop in.
